title: AITA for getting upset at my girlfriend for getting a ride from someone I don't like
question: AITA for getting upset at my girlfriend for getting a ride from someone I don't like
body:
My girlfriend has known this guy longer than she has known me. I have also had female friends longer than I have known her.

She told me that she prefers that I no longer have female friends because it makes her uncomfortable, and said she would do the same and not have guy friends anymore if I dont want her to. 

I told her I dont really care if she talks to guys, but theres only one guy in particular I don't like. 

Her car isn't great, and she claims it might not make the trip. She wanted to visit her best friend for a birthday party an hour away. He was going to the party as well and offered to give her a ride. 

Am I the asshole for getting upset that she rode with him to the party?
